name: pharma-detective-api
description: Results and published settings for the Pharma Detective game (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

TEACHER_KEY.description: The instructor key. Instructors type it in the game's dashboard to publish settings and read results. Use three or more words plus a number, e.g. `bamboo-lantern-kidney-27`, and do not give it to students.

DB.description: Stores students' game results and the instructor's published settings. Created for you.
